requirements.requirement: The system must render the clinical trial phase label (I/II/III/IV) correctly in the MessageBubble UI when valid phase data is provided.
The system must display a plain-language explanation corresponding to the rendered phase that matches the mapping defined in EVAL-CT-PHASE-UX-S2.
The system must display the score contribution value for the phase within the same scorecard UI component.
The system must render phase label, explanation, and score contribution together within a single MessageBubble instance.
The system must ensure the explanation text is human-readable and contains no raw codes or backend identifiers.
The system must validate that each phase value (I, II, III, IV) maps to a distinct explanation string.
The system must render identical phase inputs consistently across multiple messages within the same ChatWindow session.
The system must ensure that the phase display does not break existing MessageBubble layout or overflow UI boundaries.
The system must validate that score contribution is numerically formatted and visible without truncation.
The system must confirm that the phase explanation semantically aligns with the phase label (e.g., Phase I reflects early safety testing).
The system must verify that no phase-related UI elements are rendered when phase data is absent.
The system must display a fallback message indicating 'Phase information unavailable' when phase data is null or undefined.
The system must handle invalid phase values (outside I–IV) by suppressing the phase label and showing a safe fallback explanation.
The system must ensure that rendering of phase data does not introduce runtime errors in ChatWindow or MessageBubble components.
The system must validate that phase-related UI content is included in automated UI test coverage and passes without manual intervention.
